integrity.explanation: The relative attaching map is computed on integer oriented generators; its kernel identifies the full integral homology representation. Finite enumeration corroborates and does not replace the proof.
integrity.status: exact integral argument with reproducible finite checks

scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the inclusive radius r on the cycle with 3r evenly spaced vertices and its natural full dihedral action.
It does not assert new ordinary homotopy types; the sphere-wedge classification is from Adamaszek, arXiv:1104.0433.
It does not determine integral homology of the quotient, equivariant homotopy types, or later critical scales.
A mathematically equivalent result in unindexed literature cannot be excluded; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Integral dihedral homology at the first critical cyclic Rips scale
